transactions.property_name: Four Points by Sheraton Nagoya, Chubu International Airport
transactions.citation: Property card (p1359-1363): 'Valuation as at 31 Dec 2025 (¥ million): 7,790 | Purchase price (¥ million): 6,000'. Note 4 Investment properties (p5540): 'On 25 April 2025, the Far East H-REIT acquired Four Points by Sheraton Nagoya, Chubu International Airport from Godo Kaisha Pothos, an unrelated third party. The valuation was based on a discounted cash flow method.' Property statement (p1796): 'Four Points by Sheraton Nagoya, Chubu International Airport | 319 | 6,000,000 | 18,807'. p1377: 'On 25 April 2025, the Trust completed the acquisition of Four Points by Sheraton Nagoya, Chubu International Airport, a freehold 319-room upscale hotel located in Greater Nagoya, Japan, following the signing of the sale and purchase agreement on 20 February 2025.'
transactions.notes: First overseas acquisition (Trust's first Japan hotel). No gain/loss concept applies to an acquisition per SPEC, so the five divestment fields are left null. The AR does NOT disclose a verbatim acquisition discount/premium percentage; a derived comparison of the JPY6,000m purchase price against the JPY7,790m independent valuation by CBRE K.K. (discounted cash flow method, as at 31 Dec 2025 -- a YEAR-END valuation roughly 8 months after completion, not an acquisition-date valuation) would give (6,000-7,790)/7,790*100 = -22.98%, but this is NOT populated as gain_loss_pct because (a) the field is reserved for divestments per SPEC and (b) the reference valuation postdates the deal by 8 months, making it a poor acquisition-date comparator (the property could simply have appreciated in that period, particularly with the JPY translation and post-acquisition operating performance both being favourable per the AR narrative). purchase_price recorded on the JPY-denominated basis as disclosed in the property card and Portfolio Statement (which state JPY, not a SGD-converted figure) -- a separate SGD-equivalent acquisition cost of ~S$56.5m (cash flow statement, per prior extraction) and an Adjusted purchase consideration of S$10,511k recognised as accruals/trade payables at the Stapled Group level (Note, p6243/6468, deferred/unpaid portion) also exist but are not used here to avoid mixing currencies or conflating the full purchase price with a deferred/unpaid tranche. Freehold, 319-room hotel, acquired via 100% ownership (no interest_pct disclosed as anything other than a full purchase, so left null).
